sections.Profile:
Wolf Man, produced by the Spanish manufacturer Peyper in 1987, is a solid-state pinball machine featuring a horror theme centered around the werewolf legend. The game is equipped with two flippers, three pop bumpers, a four-bank drop target, and two captive balls. A distinctive feature of Wolf Man is the inclusion of round knobs on each side of the cabinet, allowing players to physically move the playfield forward, backward, right, and left, adding a unique interactive dimension to the game.

- Manufacturer: Peyper
- Years made: 1987
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Myth and Legend, Original Theme, Solid State, Animals, Monsters, Horror, 1980s
